levels.title: Flutter 3.29 host migration
summary: Android removes v1 embedding Java APIs; migrate any app or local plugin still using PluginRegistry.Registrar or old embedding classes.
The 3.29.3 template uses Gradle 8.10.2, AGP 8.7.0, Kotlin 1.8.22, Kotlin DSL, and Java/JVM target 11; use these as comparison baselines, not forced values.
The tcm-app upgrade added android/app/.cxx to android/.gitignore and enabled GPU validation in the iOS Run scheme.
Flutter 3.29.3 bundles Dart 3.7.2; ensure pubspec's Dart constraint admits the bundled Dart version.

levels.title: Flutter 3.32 generated plugin metadata migration
summary: .flutter-plugins-dependencies replaces .flutter-plugins; update custom scripts or legacy settings.gradle logic that parses .flutter-plugins.
Do not commit generated plugin metadata files; regenerate them with flutter pub get/build.

levels.title: Flutter 3.35 Android ABI and iOS baseline migration
summary: Raise the iOS deployment target to 13.0 consistently in AppFrameworkInfo.plist, all IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET entries, and the Podfile platform when present.
Add $(SRCROOT)/Flutter/ephemeral/flutter_lldbinit to TestAction and LaunchAction in the shared Runner scheme when missing.
Flutter now sets default Android abiFilters for non-debuggable builds; inspect custom ABI filters in defaultConfig, buildTypes, and productFlavors and migrate intentionally.
Flutter 3.35.7 bundles Dart 3.9.x; ensure pubspec's Dart constraint admits the selected patch release.

levels.title: Flutter 3.38 Android toolchain and iOS UIScene readiness
summary: Use Java 17 or newer supported by the selected Gradle version; the 3.38.10 template targets Java/JVM 17.
The 3.38.10 template baseline is Gradle 8.14, AGP 8.11.1, and Kotlin 2.2.20. Upgrade the trio together after checking project plugins.
Remove android.enableJetifier=true only after verifying all dependencies are AndroidX-native.
Flutter 3.38 provides UIScene lifecycle migration APIs. Inspect customized AppDelegate and plugin lifecycle logic before adopting FlutterSceneDelegate; 3.41 makes app migration the default.
Flutter 3.38.10 bundles Dart 3.10.9; ensure pubspec's Dart constraint admits the bundled Dart version.
Update .metadata revision fields only through Flutter's own migration behavior; do not fabricate revision hashes.
